from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1'
assert not OUT.exists(),'来源资格实验已存在，不能覆盖。'
OUT.mkdir();(OUT/'sources').mkdir()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
specs=[
{'id':'subscription_reform_announcement','date':'2015-11-06','family':'CONTEXT_PAYMENT_MECHANISM','stage':'征求意见和过渡安排','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c1001838/content.shtml','checks':['2015-11-06','取消现行的新股申购预先缴款制度'],'model_role':'机制背景，不将改革建议当实施'},
{'id':'subscription_settlement_qa','date':None,'family':'CONTEXT_PAYMENT_MECHANISM','stage':'流程问答','url':'https://www.sse.com.cn/ipo/rules/others/c/c_20210514_5463626.shtml','checks':['T+2','原T+1日申购资金验资环节取消'],'model_role':'仅校核支付环节；迁站路径不认证首次发布时间'},
{'id':'registration_transition','date':'2023-02-01','family':'REGISTRATION_REFORM','stage':'公开启动与过渡通知','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7047622/content.shtml','checks':['2023-02-01','过渡期安排'],'model_role':'同一改革前置信息'},
{'id':'registration_implementation','date':'2023-02-17','family':'REGISTRATION_REFORM','stage':'制度正式实施','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shanghai/c105566/c7155731/content.shtml','checks':['2023-02-17','发布实施'],'model_role':'同一改革后续实施，不当新独立政策'},
{'id':'supply_tightening','date':'2023-08-27','family':'COUNTERCYCLICAL_TIGHTENING','stage':'政策安排','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7428481/content.shtml','checks':['2023-08-27','阶段性收紧IPO节奏'],'model_role':'来源资格，不预设净股票需求方向'},
{'id':'not_closed_clarification','date':'2023-09-15','family':'COUNTERCYCLICAL_TIGHTENING','stage':'官方澄清','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7432482/content.shtml','checks':['2023-09-15','关闸'],'model_role':'约束范围解释，不按日复制新事件'},
{'id':'sse_refinancing_details','date':'2023-11-08','family':'COUNTERCYCLICAL_TIGHTENING','stage':'具体执行说明','url':'https://www.sse.com.cn/listing/announcement/notification/c/c_20231108_10764652.shtml','checks':['2023-11-08','前期已受理'],'model_role':'上海市场适用范围与例外'},
{'id':'szse_refinancing_details','date':'2023-11-08','family':'COUNTERCYCLICAL_TIGHTENING','stage':'具体执行说明','url':'https://www.szse.cn/aboutus/trends/news/t20231108_604521.html','checks':['2023-11-08','前期已受理'],'model_role':'深圳市场适用范围与例外；同日同根不重复计数'},
{'id':'quality_framework','date':'2024-03-15','family':'LISTING_QUALITY_FRAMEWORK','stage':'意见试行','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7467846/content.shtml','checks':['2024-03-15','逆周期调节'],'model_role':'质量与发行监管同时调整，非确定吸收金额'},
{'id':'quality_draft_details','date':'2024-04-12','family':'LISTING_QUALITY_FRAMEWORK','stage':'新闻发布及规则草案征求意见','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100029/c7473708/content.shtml','checks':['2024-04-12','公开征求意见'],'model_role':'明确草案与实施时点区别'},
{'id':'quality_issuance_guidance','date':'2024-05-15','family':'LISTING_QUALITY_FRAMEWORK','stage':'指引发布实施','url':'https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7480506/content.shtml','checks':['2024-05-15','即日起实施'],'model_role':'同一框架的信息披露实施，不等于确定募资量'}]
paths=['reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1/unique_documents.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1/catalogue_occurrences.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1/query_windows.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_fiscal_deposit_cause_score_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/protocol.json']
stamp=datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_EQUITY_SUPPLY_CONSTRAINT_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E3','registered_at':stamp,
'phase':'SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_BEFORE_NEW_SCORE','previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E2_FIXED_INCREMENT_COMPLETED_AND_REJECTED',
'question':'全市场IPO/再融资约束是否能产生当时可知、不同于原融资净变化的股票供给或支付占用状态？',
'authority':'继续当前历史指数原因goal；仍遵守先不要修改代码。仅项目Python标准输入和JSON程序回执。',
'fixed_source_route':specs,'source_route_budget':'11个已定位官方HTML，3并发、每URL最多2次；403/429不重试，保留失败。不采集全证券发行全文或增大发行公告范围。',
'cached_catalogue_check':'读取原74129个历史成员发行目录与检索任务状态，确认覆盖、角色及同一发行程序的多份公告；不是建立新经济事件日历。',
'candidate_field_admission':[
'明确描述股票供给/支付占用约束，不能只把政策后标为0/1或把宣传方向当现金金额',
'原文可知日、适用项目状态/例外、公告到执行再到缴款/资金到账有可用字段',
'全市场连续覆盖或明确一致的指数总体测量单位；后纳入历史成员的IPO不能冒充当时全市场发行',
'重复解释、同日两所同步、同政策实施不当独立冲击；每日填充不生成新政策事实',
'若只有少量政策根、事后总额或目录标题，来源门不通过，保留NOT_RUN并结束本路线'],
'data_time_rules':'有明确原文公开日则保守取23:59:59；不把文件迁站URL日期当最早公布日；实施与公布分开。订阅流程问答为机制背景，首次时点未知则不入历史输入。',
'causal_boundaries':'发行减少既可能伴随现金需求减少，也可能反映市场疲弱或发行需求下降；融资批文/申报/计划不是实际资金交收。规则包同时改变需求与供给，不把其后指数涨跌归因IPO单条。',
'price_scope':'仅使用既有68月的时点元数据检查连接可能性，不加载或计算新事件收益，不拟合，不新跑账户。',
'old_directions_retained':'旧M06/T13来源缺口、减持政策、融资保证金、印花税与所有宏观评分失败不重开；本来源资格不撤销它们。',
'completion_boundary':'交付来源和关键适用事实、覆盖计数、能否定义连续字段的裁决。不以没有计算策略夏普等同机制失败或全目标完成。',
'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_market_downloads':0,
'new_official_source_pages_max':len(specs),'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW',
'position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'before_new_source_fields_or_scores':True,
'protocol_sha256':sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),
'input_hashes':{name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in paths if name!=paths[-1]},
'authority_config_snapshots':{name:json.loads((ROOT/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for name in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']}}
(OUT/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('E3来源资格已固定：11官方HTML上限；不拟合、不计算新策略收益。')
